title: Strategies to Address Energy Affordability
content: Energy affordability is THE topic at utility convenings and regulatory proceedings and, most importantly, with customers. Matt Nelson, former chair of the Massachusetts Department of Public Utilities, noted at a recent meeting with utility executives that “Customers are waking up, showing up and they are angry!”1
author: Penni McLean‐Conner
